title: Weirs Beach Go-Kart Track
specs: Go-karts reach speeds up to 20 mph
Drivers must be at least 4 feet 8 inches (56 inches) tall
Drivers of passengers must be at least 16 years old
Passengers must be ages 4-9 years old only
Drivers must be able to safely operate the kart
Six-race package can be shared among family and friends
Picnic tables available for birthday parties and group gatherings
blurb: Guests race go-karts on a quarter-mile outdoor track. Each race lasts 5 minutes. The track is family-friendly with passenger seats for children ages 4-9.
extraNote: No reservations required; tickets purchased at ticket window only · Passengers ages 4-9 ride free with age 16+ driver · At the go-kart track ticket window at 582 Endicott Street North, Laconia, NH · May 30 through Labor Day
